weeks.note: Re-entry. Madeira's 2,003 m of descent is an eccentric-damage event - strength markers return to baseline around day 9 and muscle damage is detectable up to 4 weeks. NO lunges, NO burpee broad jumps, NO heavy sled this week or next: those are precisely the movements your quads cannot absorb yet. Ergs, grip and technique only. SWIMMING STARTS NOW. Swim frequency beats swim volume: 4 x 30-40 min beats 2 x 75, because fatigue compromises motor learning. Never let a gap exceed 5 days - adult-onset swimmers lose motor patterns fast. Book private lessons NOW for weeks 1-8.

sessions.label: Easy run 5 km (talk test)
Swim 30 min - TECHNIQUE. Breathing, body position, catch. Distance is irrelevant for six weeks.

ERG technique only - SkiErg hinge (80% of power is the first third of the pull), rower damper 3-4 for a light athlete. No legs. LOWER-LEG AND FOOT, about 5 min at the end: tibialis anterior raises 3 x 15-20 (heels on a step, toes lifting), heel walks 2 x 20 m, eccentric dorsiflexion 3 x 10 slow against a band, short-foot holds 3 x 30 s per side, tennis ball under the arch 60 s. An 8-week RCT in amateur runners raised lactate threshold velocity 5.9% with intrinsic foot work - but that was 30 min DAILY, so treat this as maintaining the tissue that failed on 7 Sep, not as a 5.9% gain.

weeks.note: Priority order from 182k measured doubles teams: running (r=0.90 with finish) > roxzone > lunges/burpees/sled pull. Wall balls correlate r=0.266 - the LOWEST of any segment in doubles. Cold immersions start this week and run through February - 5-6 short exposures halve the cold-shock response, which is the mechanism behind most swim DNFs and 90 of 120 recorded sudden deaths in US triathlon.

TACTICS: (1) expect R8 to be your slowest run at every level - it is for everyone; (2) a controlled 12-15% positive split is optimal, even pacing is NOT a lever (measured dR2 = 0.000); (3) never let the sled stop - at 56 kg you pay the breakaway cost every restart; (4) grippy solid-rubber shoes are worth 30-60 s on the sled; (5) don't chase wall balls, flex that split to whoever is holding up.
